text:
incident-bot: P1 alert created: Audit-ingest pipeline lag + auth failures detected for Redwood Private tenants. Incident ID INC-2026-0315-07. Paging oncall.

Maya: I got the page, looking now. seeing ingestion errors from rs-ingest-svc -> 403s to s3-backend for a subset of tenant keys.

AJ: Noted. Is this affecting hosted API?

Maya: No, hosted unaffected. Only Private/VPC customers using external S3/KMS combos. probable IAM token rotation mismatch.

Leah: Customers affected: cust-alpha, cust-gamma, cust-delta. Product Support notified via DM, prepping comms.

Product Support: Sending initial outreach to alpha/gamma now. telling them we are investigating, possible log delivery gaps ~35-50m.

Samir: Oncall handoff in 20m, I'm pairing with @Maya to ensure safe transition.

Maya: Quick mitigation: throttled retries to avoid backpressure and started a parallel export to ephemeral bucket in our region. Command I ran: ```
# ephemeral export
rwctl logs export --tenant cust-alpha --start 2026-03-15T09:10:00Z --end now --dest s3://redwood-temp-ingest/INC-2026-0315-07
```

ops-sre: Confirmed export accepted. watch for rate limit. started capture of request/response headers for forensic evidence.

security-bot: Evidence collection checklist attached. Reminder: preserve original S3 request IDs and KMS key IDs, capture STS token exchange logs, and make a WORM snapshot for affected buckets.

Leah: Important for compliance: auditors may require continuous audit logs. Need to quantify gap and memo.

AJ: I'm seeing a spike in 403s tied to the KMS key rotation event at 2026-03-15T08:58Z. KMS logs show an attempted re-encryption with old key id.

Maya: Rolling back to previous token config for the affected region now. If rollback works we can resume ingestion while we stabilize key policy.

Samir: After rollback accepted, ingestion resumed for cust-alpha. gamma still queued.

Product Support: Customer status update sent to alpha/gamma/delta: "We observed delayed delivery of audit logs between ~08:58-09:34 UTC. Partial mitigation in progress. We will follow up with timeline + evidence."

ops-sre: Captured timeline from our side: initial failure spike 08:58:12 UTC, mitigation rollback started 09:07:30 UTC, first resumed successful put 09:12:06 UTC.

Leah: That matches export sizes. Gap window ~16-16.5 minutes primary, but queued backlog shows missing entries up to 45m for delta (they had intermittent retries). Need to call this out precisely in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-07 severity reduced to P2 at 09:25:00 UTC after mitigation. Oncall changed to Samir at 09:40 UTC (handoff).

Samir: Taking over. Will run verification sweep across affected tenants and kick off post-incident tasks.

security-bot: Action: start evidence export to secure archive. Use: ```
redwood-sec export-evidence --incident INC-2026-0315-07 --tenants cust-alpha,cust-gamma,cust-delta --keep-worm
```

Maya: Note — audit log ingestion is best-effort for private connectors. We need a stronger SLA for compliance tenants.

Leah: Agreed. Add an immediate action item: tighten alerting for 'audit-ingest-lag' and add an SRE runbook step for KMS key-rotation fallout.

AJ: I'll open a config change to add an automated validation job that runs after any KMS rotation. Draft rule: run 5m post-rotation, attempt endpoint writes with rotation-aware tokens.

Samir: Postmortem scheduling — propose 2026-03-17 1600 UTC, 60m. Invite: Maya, AJ, Leah, ops-sre, security, product support, and reps from affected customers if they want.

Product Support: Calendar invite sent to internal list. I'll coordinate customer-facing timeline with comms team.

Leah: Creating post-incident doc and primary action item tracker. Initial items: [1] Root cause RCA (AJ), [2] Evidence archive and attestation (security-bot / elena), [3] Alerting/runbook updates (ops-sre / Maya), [4] Customer impact statement and comms (Product Support).

elena: Security will own the evidence package. We need signed attestations that exports are bit-for-bit of original captured requests. Will run hash checks.

security-bot: Forensics step: capture STS logs, S3 request IDs, KMS key usage logs, and syslog of ingestion service. Store artifacts in secure vault with access tags: INC-2026-0315-07, compliance.

Maya: FYI — I recorded the mitigation steps in ops-runbook: toggled retry backoff, temporary rollback of token provider binding, started ephemeral export. Will link the runbook in the postmortem doc.

Samir: Follow-up items with owners and due dates: 
- AJ: implement post-KMS-rotation validation job (due 2026-03-25)
- elena/security: finalize evidence package + hashes (due 2026-03-18)
- ops-sre: add alert rule for 'audit-ingest-gap > 5m' + runbook updates (due 2026-03-22)
- Product Support: customer impact letters + logs attached (due 2026-03-18)

Leah: Also add: identify customers with regulatory needs (SOC2/ISO/FINRA) and schedule a compliance sync to confirm logs meet retention and chain-of-custody.

Product Support: Noted. contacting compliance officers for the affected customers now.

AJ: Quick patch note for infra: discovered config drift in token-rotation handler where new token TTL was not propagated to the private connector. Pushing fix to staging.

Maya: Any outstanding evidence or steps before we close the incident thread?

security-bot: Need confirmation that all affected tenants' exports are in the secure archive and hashes verified. Please bump when done.

elena: Starting archive verification now, will post hashes when complete.

ops-sre: I've scheduled an internal follow-up run in 48h to make sure no regressions and to validate alert noise.

Samir: Thanks everyone. We'll treat this as P1->P2 -> follow-up. Postmortem draft will include timeline, impact per tenant, evidence appendix, and remediation plan.

Maya: One last note for the audit trail — tagging the incident artifacts with customer consent flags as some tenants require pre-notification before data exports to our temp bucket. Product Support, double-check approvals for cust-delta export.

Product Support: Confirmed we have explicit consent for alpha/gamma. For delta we're waiting on a one-line approval from their compliance contact — chasing now.

Leah: Good catch. If consent missing, stop any non-production exports and rely only on preserved original requests in our network capture.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0315-07 updated: mitigated at 09:25 UTC, actions captured, postmortem scheduled. Closing thread for real-time coordination. Continue follow-ups in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
